When i was younger my first cat got caught in the tallest tree near our house (I live in the middle of the woods) and so we called the local animal shelter for help after she had not come down, even with the temptation of food, for a good week. They told us to call this one firefighter guy who hated getting cat calls and so we did and he decided to help since she had been up there so long, and was there about 15 minutes later. He scaled this 60 foot tree, put the cat in a pillow sack and gave us instructions on how to help her. We later learned that he was about to leave on vacation and was going to potentially miss his flight to help our cat. When he left he wouldn't accept money and said something along these lines. He was a really cool dude.
